fields.error.embedded: {name} has an embed line, so its type is the card at the other end. To change the type, first remove the embed line (line: embed) from the card's connections (removing it returns the type to string)
fields.error.exists: The field "{name}" already exists at the same level
fields.error.nestedLeft: Nested fields remain ({count}). Delete the fields inside first
fields.error.noFields: {card} is a {kind}, so it has no fields. {instead}
fields.error.parentIsCustomRow: {parent} is a row of a custom card. To add a row under a row, use card_create and write type, text, etc. in value
fields.error.parentIsFormatRow: {parent} is a row of a formatdoc. To add a row inside an item, use card_create and write kind in value, plus what that kind holds (heading, body, etc.)
fields.error.parentNotObject: {parent} is of type {kind}, so no field can be created inside it. To nest fields, first make {parent} an object type
fields.error.pathNotField: The path "{path}" does not point to a field. Start it with the card name, e.g. User.email, User.profile.bio
fields.label.name: Field name
fields.warn.pathsRewritten: Rewrote {rewritten} paths written in the project to follow the name
